This often happens in scenarios with an excessively rich fuel mixture or incomplete combustion. For instance, in direct-injection diesel engines, when fuel is injected at very high pressures, there can be instances where fuel manages to pass between the pistons and cylinder walls, diluting the engine oil over time.

My investigation revealed that the less volatile components of the fuel tend to condense first, meaning the dilution's severity is closely tied to the volatility of the fuel mixture.

I also developed preventive strategies to mitigate the risk of crankcase dilution, such as optimizing injection timing and ensuring proper oil selection to enhance engine protection. This experience has equipped me with a solid grasp of internal combustion engine mechanics and reinforced the importance of addressing crankcase dilution to maintain optimal engine health.

Transitioning between clubs sharpened my adaptability and resilience, as each new team brought different challenges and dynamics. My time at Örebro SK in Sweden was a particularly defining moment; although I faced competition for my position, I worked diligently to improve my game and contributed significantly before transferring to HNK Rijeka.

Through all of these experiences, I have developed a strong foundation in strategic thinking, teamwork, and adaptability, which I believe are essential skills in any professional setting.

During my time living and working in Brazil, I had the opportunity to immerse myself in the local culture and geography of Cachoeira Paulista, a municipality in São Paulo State. This experience greatly enriched my perspective on community engagement and environmental conservation.

Cachoeira Paulista is situated at an altitude of 521 meters and is part of the Metropolitan Region of Vale do Paraíba. It’s an area that not only has a rich history, dating back to its foundation in the late 18th century but also serves as a hub for scientific research with the Brazilian Decimetric Array radio telescope located there. My connection to this region allowed me to appreciate how both history and science can coexist and be leveraged for community development.

I also learned about the importance of environmental protection in the region, particularly the part that Cachoeira Paulista plays in the Mananciais do Rio Paraíba do Sul Environmental Protection Area. This initiative, established in 1982, is crucial for safeguarding the water sources for the surrounding communities. Through my involvement in local projects focused on sustainability, I realized the vital role that responsible management of natural resources plays in supporting both economic growth and the well-being of residents.

By engaging with local communities and understanding their needs and the historical context of areas like Cachoeira Paulista, I have developed a deeper appreciation for the interconnectedness of social, environmental, and economic factors. This experience has significantly shaped my approach to project management, community outreach, and environmental stewardship, qualities I am excited to bring to your organization.

In my previous experience working in the contemporary art sector, I had the opportunity to engage closely with Greene Naftali Gallery, a well-respected establishment located in Chelsea, New York City. Founded in 1995 by Carol Greene and Gloria Naftali, the gallery is known for its innovative approach to contemporary art across various media, including painting, video, music, and fashion. 

Under the leadership of Carol Greene, an accomplished art dealer and Harvard graduate, the gallery has built a strong reputation for championing both emerging and historical artists. Some of the artists I admire who have been associated with the gallery are Rachel Harrison and Dan Graham. My involvement with Greene Naftali has significantly shaped my understanding of the art world, particularly in how galleries can influence contemporary discourse and support artists in their creative endeavors.

Additionally, the gallery is not just a space for visual art; it also hosts a range of performance programming, which has included music events featuring prominent figures like Thurston Moore. This diverse programming has provided me with insights into how interdisciplinary approaches can attract varied audiences and foster a more dynamic art community.

Working in such an innovative environment has taught me the importance of collaboration and the impact of strategic initiatives in promoting art. I believe my experience with Greene Naftali Gallery, both in terms of the foundational concepts of contemporary art and the operational aspects of a successful gallery, equips me with a unique perspective that I can bring to your team.
